description.description: A close-up photograph of a person's palm holding two distinct specimens. The top specimen is a rectangular, flat-cut slice of a lunar meteorite breccia, showing a mosaic of light gray clasts and dark matrix with small rusty spots. The bottom specimen is a rough, irregularly shaped, dark charcoal-to-black textured rock.
